why: Node cuts the PR description with String.prototype.slice(0, 4000) (UTF-16 units). When the cut falls inside a surrogate pair the prompt keeps a lone high surrogate, which JSON and Go strings cannot carry. Go drops the dangling half and still reports truncated=true. goldens/prompt.json (nodeSurrogate) records what Node does; the generator checks that this file's nodeBehaviour matches it.
